decisions.evidence: The observed Example used rhoE=|0><0| without a ket/bra definition or a choice of unit basis vector; def-qc-density-operator does not define that notation. Independently checked def-qc-dirac-notation-conversion: its rank-one map is z -> <z,y>x under the first-argument-linear convention. Replaced the ambiguous notation by the explicit endomorphism rhoE(z0,z1)=(z0,0) on C^2 with its specified standard Hermitian inner product. This map has eigenvalues 1,0, is a nonnegative trace-one projection, and leaves all product identities and the value k_B log 2 unchanged. Updated the manifest instance, contract finite input and step 5.1. No item consumer uses this example; its only page occurrence is inventory placement.
